test_item_verbatim: IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Med" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Med" and sends this signal to IPC
remarks: Provisional: SYSRA-anchored (R-VT18); re-anchor upon 037 (DR-VT1); UI names taken verbatim from spec 1.11.1.1.4 paras 531 and 541, including the spec spellings "Lanse Sense Strenght" and the PROXI value "Leve 3"/"Leve 2" (R-6/R-13, filed to DR-VT2); HMI Settings List `Settings` r282B carries "Lane Departure Warning" (Technical Reference VF230/VF665, CFTS022)

tcs.tc_title: Lanse Sense Strenght 2 request sent for med selection
tcs.pre_conditions:
PROXI Half_HMI_Setting = Leve 2
The menu item "Lanse Sense Strenght 2" is displayed and reachable
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select "Lanse Sense Strenght 2" = "Med" on the TLM display
2. Read the signal $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req$ and check that it is 1 (Med)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The menu item "Lanse Sense Strenght 2" shows "Med"
2. The signal value $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req$ = 1 (Med) is received
tcs.test_item:
IF the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Med" THEN TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Med" and sends this signal to IPC

(Lanse Sense Strenght 2 request sent for med selection)

reasoning: 驗證目標為使用者選定該選項後，TLM 送出對應 B-CAN 訊號之值。關鍵情境條件為該 PROXI 等級成立且選單項可達；設定動作走 UI 路徑（R-P375(b)），因 LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req／LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req 為內部訊號，其驅動面即規格具名之選單項（R-VL21(a)）。本列只述單一選項，一條足夠；同族其餘選項由各自之列涵蓋（§8.2.1）。ER 用 is received 式（DUT 送出，R-VL21(e)）；raw 與 label 逐字取 val_tables_v43.tsv。
